headline: Ownership Flips Stir Six Contested Fronts
war_summary: Since the last edition, the battle ledger has quickened on several fronts. Fisherman’s Row is now the most immediate flashpoint, recording six ownership events in two hours and 20 in the day, with eight Warden-held bases against one Colonial-held. Stlican Shelf has also erupted, posting six events in two hours and 34 over 24, while its nine bases stand at three Warden, four Colonial, and two neutral. Callahan’s Passage has shed its recent lull: two fresh events bring the daily count to 13 amid sharply accelerating casualties, though Wardens still hold nine of its ten bases. Marban Hollow reports three events in two hours, with nine in the day, and remains a seven-to-one Colonial majority. Weathered Expanse adds three recent events and 26 over the day, its six-to-three Warden lead still unsettled. Deadlands has seen no event in the latest two hours but four in six and 15 across the day, retaining a two-Warden, nine-Colonial split. Stonecradle remains active by the longer clock, with five events in six hours.
